text:
raj: Pager integration alert — incident-bot didn't page most of oncall for PROD cpu-spike (~service-cpu > 90%). Pagerbot logs show 502s from notifylink gateway. Also incident channel never auto-created. Anyone seeing the same?

pagerbot: [automated] delivery_failures=68 target=notifylink response=502 url=https://notifylink.internal/webhook id=pgb-49382

linda: i'm on-call and didn't get a page. got a slack DM from samir only.

samir: confirmed. i got a few slack dms. manual call to ajohnson got through. twilio fallback didn't trigger automatically.

ajohnson: i'm on it, triaging hosts now. thanks for the heads up.

raj: samir — can you pull the notifylink gateway logs? maybe signing rotation or header change.

samir: pulling now. snippet from gateway: ```
2026-04-20T02:01:05Z ERROR webhook POST /notify 502 upstream_error: upstream response truncated
2026-04-20T02:01:05Z WARN missing-header: X-Signature truncated length=0 expected=88
```

linda: that truncated header smell looks like the new proxy compression change we rolled yesterday. @ops-bot do we have a config that trims headers > 64 bytes? :thinking_face: 

ops-bot: config-change: proxy/header_trim_enabled=true applied 2026-04-19T23:50:12 by deploy-bot

samir: ah — notifylink expects full X-Signature (88 chars). proxy was trimming longer headers and notifylink returns 502 -> pagerbot treats as permanent delivery failure and doesn't trigger fallback.

raj: immediate mitigation: disable header_trim on proxy and restart notifylink connector. also enable manual fallback to twilio for critical severity. can someone run the commands?

ajohnson: running disable now. command: ```
kubectl -n edge patch configproxy --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/header_trim_enabled","value":false}]'
```

samir: restarted connector and replayed 10 failed webhooks. pagerbot now shows deliveries reprocessed, ~48 successful. fallback flow still needs a fix.

pagerbot: [automated] replay=10 success=8 failed=2

linda: manual paging/result: we had a median notification delay of 12m for affected users. 4 customers opened support with delayed alerts; no data loss reported. logging indicates most affected oncall rotations were using notifylink primary.

raj: customer-impact note: SLO miss for paging latency (critical alerts) for ~00:12 - 00:35 UTC. ops reached owners by phone where slack failed. Need comms?

product-oncall: please draft a brief customer note: "Paging delays noticed; mitigation in place; investigating root cause and will update with timeline." keep it short.

samir: opened a short jira: INFR-1287 "proxy header trim caused notifylink 502 -> missed pages" with remediation tasks (revert config, add e2e webhook tests, ensure fallback triggers on 5xx).

linda: also note incident-bot failed to auto-create channel because it couldn't POST to /incidents due to same 502 path. manual channel created: #inc-1719007777-manual and we ran the bridge. that handoff added friction to ops.

ajohnson: agreed — next actions: 1) revert proxy header change from rollout; 2) add integration test to alerting pipeline to send a signed webhook and assert delivery; 3) modify pagerbot to treat upstream 5xx as immediate fallback to twilio/sms.

raj: assigning: samir -> fix proxy + tests; linda -> postmortem writeup + timeline; ajohnson -> pagerbot fallback PR. update this thread with links to PRs/tickets. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-failure

samir: config reverted and notifylink restarted. watching deliveries for next 30m. will paste PR link when ready.

linda: thanks all. will schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow and include oncall rotation notes so handoff friction is captured.

raj: closing live mitigation. leave thread open for postmortem artifacts.
